column1: ['Bounded to the stated listing/rule/window contract. The general optimizer-independent ceiling is refuted by a three-gate SWAP+REMOVAL counterexample; historical SA/RLS/GA rows also predate the incumbent fix.']
Claim: Under the frozen flat-listing and adjacent-Greedy predicate
Manuscript_Location: listing order changes which local cancellations are exposed and changes achieved reduction.
Evidence_Type: Future manuscript must be rebuilt from the 2026-08-10 theory gate
Limitations_Caveats: data/v7/e19_extended/; data/v10/prepaper/analysis/rq1/

Claim: Phase-2a commutation rewriting provides context-dependent improvement on select circuit families.
Limitations_Caveats: Improvement is family-dependent. Phase-2a empirical results do not prove Phase-2b template-assisted theorems.

Claim: Production compiler gap analysis reveals mechanisms beyond the prototype peephole model.
Limitations_Caveats: Hardware-specific effects not fully modeled. Cirq/t|ket> comparisons are present in E20 but require independent verification. Path repaired 2026-10-26: E12/E15 canonical data live in data/v4/ (data/v5/e12 never existed).

Claim: Phase-2a window size w affects the trade-off between optimization power and runtime.
Limitations_Caveats: Underpowered comparison (reported power=0.126); treat saturation as empirical trend not confirmed design rule. 2026-10-26: the corrected E26 sampled200 estimator (data/v10/prepaper/e26/) supersedes the naive-sampling caveat for any E26-adjacent reuse; E16 power remains 0.126.

Claim: Hardware topology constraints affect optimization opportunities differently.
Limitations_Caveats: Simplified topology models. Real hardware has additional noise/error effects not modeled.

Claim: Clifford+T gate-set decomposition preserves some Phase-2 value among surviving rows.
Limitations_Caveats: Survivorship-biased: decomposition/fidelity failures are excluded. Do not generalize to failed rows or full attempted population.

Claim: Functionality is preserved for outputs carrying an accepted exact or explicitly sampled fidelity certificate; unavailable and invalid outputs remain in ITT denominators.
Manuscript_Location: Future manuscript must be rebuilt from the frozen protocol
Limitations_Caveats: The unitary-only contract excludes measurement/reset/classical control and symbolic parameter equivalence. Sampled evidence is probabilistic and must not be labelled exact.

Claim: The Phase-1 reduction ceiling is formally established for bounded circuits with the bounded INSERTION cascade gap resolved.
Limitations_Caveats: The unbounded INSERTION cascade remains open. QMA-hardness of CODP remains separate theoretical motivation.

Claim: Listing-model dependency: WCL-style preprocessing exposes Phase-1 opportunities hidden under LBL.
Limitations_Caveats: Cross-family relisting coverage is complete for the recorded 15-family matrix. The qwalk_8 80 rows use structural-preservation evidence rather than exact 9-qubit Operator checks. Phase-2 commutation opportunities under WCL remain separately unmeasured.

Claim: Ceiling-aware optimization can skip futile optimization passes with identical reduction and significant speedup.
Limitations_Caveats: Exact fidelity verified only for n<=6; larger circuits use target=None (correctness is covered by unit tests).

Claim: Multi-compiler extension with Cirq and t|ket> produces comparable reduction and runtime data.
Limitations_Caveats: Baseline compiler settings are standardized but may not reflect optimal per-family tuning.

Claim: Phase-2b template-assisted BV advantage is theoretically proved and the required template is implemented and unit-tested.
Limitations_Caveats: Do not conflate Phase-2b with Phase-2a. Full-scale Phase-2b evidence is complete for the recorded v2 grid (2,427 rows); parity-gadget templates and broader natural-family coverage remain open. 2026-10-26: E26 sampled200 corrected estimator is in data/v10/prepaper/e26/ (C13 references it); use it instead of the raw per-seed mean.

Claim: The corrected non-empty-stage AG generator yields zero adjacent-Greedy reduction on the tested v10 grid.
Manuscript_Location: Future manuscript must be rebuilt from the 2026-08-10 theory gate
Limitations_Caveats: Generator-specific only. The general Aaronson-Gottesman canonical-form claim is withdrawn; the pre-fix n=2 seed=35 circuit is a fixed counterexample.

Claim: Explicit artificial circuit family with R1=0 and R_{1+2a} >= 1/6.
Limitations_Caveats: Construction uses even n>=4; odd n and minimal n=2 not tested.

Claim: Phase-2b template matching is validated on the recorded 2,427-row grid. For the all-ones BV row at each n=3..10, the explicit pipeline matches the constructed reduction 2n/(3n+2); the 80-secret descriptive mean is 69.2%.
Manuscript_Location: Future manuscript must be rebuilt from the 2026-08-10 theory gate
Limitations_Caveats: The construction proves an achieved reduction for the stated listing/template pipeline, not that n+2 is a global gate-count optimum. Results for other secrets and families are descriptive and contract-specific.

Claim: Repaired ceiling model (mechanism-gate + random-forest hybrid) achieves LOFO MAE 0.0172 (r=0.977; Spearman rho=0.853; R^2=0.954), beating the predict-0 baseline MAE of 0.0963.
Limitations_Caveats: CNOT fold MAE 0.000 (closed by a mechanism gate selected post hoc on a single dataset); family-mean target n=15 underpowered (r=0.059); 11/15 folds have undefined Pearson r; auxiliary classifier F1=0.075; remains exploratory. Wave-6 20-family robustness (docs/review/wave6/e27_part5.md): pooled MAE 0.0188; r=0.967; family-mean r=0.780 (pure RF) / 0.887 (gated) at n=20; RepetitionCode fold failure MAE 0.303; r=-0.826 (intermediate-density extrapolation); remains exploratory.

Claim: Noise-model hardware validation: BV 46.15% logical reduction collapses to 0% after L1 physical transpilation; random instances show small positive Hellinger drift (+0.0016 to +0.0033) in all 4 unitary-verified cases.
Limitations_Caveats: Noise-model simulation on fake backends - NOT real hardware. Only 2 retired-device snapshots; small n; do not extrapolate.

Claim: Gate-shuffle ablation controls for gate-order effects: counterintuitively shuffled circuits yield higher greedy Phase-1 reduction than original (10.34% vs 6.30%; MWU p=6.8e-15); Phase-2a difference not significant (p=0.462).
Limitations_Caveats: Shuffle preserves the gate multiset but not circuit semantics; interpretation limited to listing-model sensitivity.

Claim: Multi-seed replication fails to reproduce E04 single-seed point estimates: RLS 0.00% to -176.5%; SA -1.6% to -22.1%; GA -0.2% to -8.3%; only hybrid stays positive at +4.69% (95% CI [4.23; 5.16]).
Limitations_Caveats: E29 uses a different circuit configuration (n=5; depth=15) than E04; E04 conclusions are seed/config fragile and must be qualified.

Corrected-engine (post successor-bug fix) re-pin at the frozen budgets: 93 exact best-cost (58 H-local + 35 enumerated escapes), 34 witness-bounded, 1 resource-bounded (e39:b2f83603 — H-local neither confirmed nor refuted at frozen budgets; raised-contract IDA* rescue in the E65 package). All quantities horizon-relative (best_cost_at_h3) and scope-relative (e44_core_v1). Supersedes the v15 "94 exact" statement. Engine source hashes pinned per cell; window claims are window-local. NEVER cite v14/v15 numbers without the engine-version qualifier.

Closure-gain decomposition: 98.2% single-qubit (two-qubit -0.53%); tket/BQSKit cross-engine closure gains are normalization artefacts (5.75x/6.40x expansion) and MUST NOT be cited. QCEC covers the closure output layer only (128/128 equivalent, 13/16 perturbation negatives — not a complete verifier). L3 non-monotonicity was FIXED upstream in qiskit 2.6.1 (E63): report as a closed regression-test case, not an open defect.

Evidence_ID: E62; E70; rotation_gap theory; bv_lower_bound theory
Limitations_Caveats: Absolute claims hold ONLY inside the {x, rz, cx} phase-polynomial fragment (Lemma 1: R >= s). Fragment-bench scaling (E70, 240 instances): NO universal g_reorder/g_total law — family structure dominates (aggregate 0.710; range 0.0 to ~1.0). BV k+2: achieved size machine-verified 24/24 (n=3..10); optimality PROVEN only for n<=3 and for k-cx circuits; general optimality OPEN (Pauli-invisible unitary; Schmidt bound only ceil((k+1)/2)). Table 11 errata: original size is 2n+k+2 (not 2n+k); the 3.1-4.2x excess range needs a source check.

Cluster=source inference MANDATORY (ICC 0.57-0.67, design effect 134-153; window-level intervals are 17-18x too narrow). D3 confound: 73,780/76,236 windows sit on unoptimized raw roots (MAX_BASELINE_GATES bypass); the 44 true greedy fixed points have zero depth-1 escapes — any window-escape headline must stratify by root kind. WCL-vs-greedy delta concentrates in 7/128 sources (all negative).

KBC census: 6,071 critical pairs, 86 valid reducing candidates, 0 without an existing-subsequence signal (no structural local gaps found; full KBC confluence out of scope — undecidable in general, arXiv:2608.18859). Full-scope panel (1,474 rules) is honestly slower per state: 54/96 exact at frozen budgets vs 61/96 at core scope. The nine exchange rules are matrix-proven sound; exchange completeness is NOT claimed (phase-adjusted permeability outside the table).
